name: Panasonic Q
significance: A collector's holy grail that materialized Nintendo and Matsushita's optical licensing agreement into a luxury living-room entertainment unit.

editorialContent.overview: A rare stainless-steel multimedia hybrid created by Panasonic, playing both standard full-size DVD movies and GameCube discs.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: A collector's holy grail that materialized Nintendo and Matsushita's optical licensing agreement into a luxury living-room entertainment unit.
